brief.notes: Graham supplied these statements: "This makes no sense to me. Why would this be a thing?" (about blocking new topics); "I want us to look much more closely at that and restructure the order and workflow." Intended point: ordinary writing should start with the author's topic; controlled generator experiments need their own boundaries. No claim that the replacement workflow has already proved better writing, saved time or improved engagement.
brief.topic: Develop one post about my recent experience trying to turn AI work into useful LinkedIn writing, focusing on how testing rules got in the way of starting from a topic or summary.
